products.name: Keshkanti
products.subtitle: Hibiscus & Bhringraj Hair Oil
products.tagline: For hair that remembers its roots.
products.description: Our signature oil. Five herbs cold-pressed into a single amber bottle. Bhringraj for strength, hibiscus for shine, amla for scalp health — a slow, patient blend that meets hair where it lives.
products.whyThisHerb: Bhringraj is Ayurveda's oldest hair herb — called kesharaj, king of hair — because its bitter compounds wake dormant follicles. We pair it with hibiscus mucilage, which coats each strand and reduces the friction that causes breakage. Cold-pressing, never heating, preserves both.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Massage into scalp for 5 minutes, circular motion.

howToUse.title: Rest
howToUse.description: Leave for 30 minutes, or overnight for deep repair.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Wash with a mild, sulfate-free shampoo.

reviews.name: Meera R.
reviews.text: Third bottle. My hairline is filling in — I didn't believe it either.

reviews.name: Aditi K.
reviews.text: The scent is heaven. My hair feels thicker after two washes.

reviews.name: Rhea S.
reviews.text: Works beautifully but the oil is heavy — use less than you think.

products.name: Amla-Pitta
products.subtitle: Amla & Neem Clarifying Oil
products.tagline: Cool the scalp. Calm the flake.
products.description: A clarifying oil for scalps that run hot. Neem's antibacterial edge, amla's vitamin C, and a whisper of camphor — for the days when your scalp needs to breathe.
products.whyThisHerb: Dandruff is not dry scalp — it's an overgrowth of a fungus called Malassezia. Neem and tea tree address it at the source. Camphor isn't for smell — it's a mild anaesthetic that stops the itch-scratch-flake loop.

howToUse.title: Apply
howToUse.description: Apply directly to the scalp, section by section.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Massage for 3 minutes — let the camphor cool.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Rinse twice. Use twice a week.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: My scalp has never been this calm. Two weeks in, flakes gone.

reviews.name: Sahil M.
reviews.text: Strong camphor smell — took a day to like, but it works.

products.name: Shirodhara
products.subtitle: Brahmi & Jatamansi Restorative Oil
products.tagline: For the night your mind won't stop.
products.description: The oil we recommend when hair loss is happening from the inside. Brahmi and jatamansi are the two herbs Ayurvedic doctors prescribe for a mind that won't rest — and a scalp that's paying for it.
products.whyThisHerb: Hair falls in cycles tied to stress — cortisol shuts down the follicle's growth phase. Brahmi and jatamansi have been used for centuries in Ayurvedic chikitsa for the nervous system. We're not making a scalp product. We're making a sleep product that happens to grow hair.

howToUse.title: Morning
howToUse.description: Wash in the morning. Three times a week.

reviews.name: Kavya R.
reviews.text: The scent alone puts me to sleep. Hair fall halved in a month.

reviews.name: Tara I.
reviews.text: My mother uses it too. Generational.

products.name: Vanaspati
products.subtitle: Coconut & Sesame Everyday Oil
products.tagline: The oil you'll reach for on Sunday.
products.description: Our weekday oil. Light, clean, and honest — two carriers, a splash of almond, nothing else. This is the bottle you keep in the shower.
products.whyThisHerb: Not everything needs a story. Sometimes your hair just needs oil. We keep this one simple because simplicity is the hardest formula to make.

howToUse.title: Pump
howToUse.description: 1 pump for short hair, 2 for long.

products.name: Pushpa
products.subtitle: Rose & Vetiver Frizz Tamer
products.tagline: For hair that fights the monsoon.
products.description: The frizz-tamer. Rose hydrosol and vetiver root oil — the combination that Ayurvedic grandmothers kept in rose-tinted glass. Heavier on the ends, lighter on the scalp.
products.whyThisHerb: Frizz is hair searching for moisture from the air. Rose and vetiver hydrate from within, so the shaft stops looking outside. Jojoba's molecular structure is nearly identical to your scalp's own sebum — which is why it absorbs without a film.

howToUse.title: Air dry
howToUse.description: Let it air-dry for best frizz control.

reviews.name: Aisha K.
reviews.text: Slightly heavy if you have fine hair. Use less.

products.name: Rasayana
products.subtitle: Ashwagandha & Amla Age-Defying Oil
products.tagline: For hair that's entering its next chapter.
products.description: For the hair that gets thinner at 45 than it was at 25. Ashwagandha, amla, and a hint of saffron — an oil for the patient body.
products.whyThisHerb: Hair thins with age because the follicle's growth cycle shortens. Ashwagandha's withanolides are being studied for their effect on telogen effluvium — the resting-hair shed. We pair it with saffron, whose crocin slows oxidative stress at the follicle.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Wash in the morning, 3 times a week.

reviews.name: Anjali P.
reviews.text: I'm 47. My hair is the thickest it's been in a decade.

reviews.name: Naveen R.
reviews.text: Good but takes 6 weeks to show.

products.name: Kumkumadi
products.subtitle: Saffron & Manjistha Scalp Oil
products.tagline: For scalps that need a reset.
products.description: Kumkumadi is Ayurveda's most referenced scalp formula — used for skin and for scalp. Saffron's crocin and manjistha's rubia — a medicinal oil for a scalp that has started to feel like work.
products.whyThisHerb: Kumkumadi is traditionally a face oil — but the same logic applies to scalp. Saffron and manjistha calm inflammation, which is what builds up when the scalp's microbiome goes out of balance.

reviews.name: Aparna S.
reviews.text: My scalp has never felt this calm.

reviews.name: Karan T.
reviews.text: The saffron is real — you can smell it.

products.name: Neelibhringadi
products.subtitle: Indigo & Bhringraj Anti-Graying Oil
products.tagline: For hair that remembers its color.
products.description: Neelibhringadi is an old Kerala formula — indigo and bhringraj suspended in coconut milk. Used for centuries for premature graying.
products.whyThisHerb: Graying isn't reversible, but its pace responds to scalp health. Indigo doesn't dye — it delivers plant pigment precursors that support melanin production at the follicle. Results are subtle, cumulative, honest.

reviews.name: Latha M.
reviews.text: Slowed my graying visibly over 3 months.

reviews.name: Ramesh S.
reviews.text: Smells like a Kerala grandmother's kitchen. I love it.

products.name: Tiladi
products.subtitle: Sesame & Fenugreek Men's Hair Oil
products.tagline: For hair that's asked to do a lot.
products.description: Built for men — because hair care shouldn't be gendered in the wrong direction. Sesame for absorption, fenugreek for shaft strength, rosemary for circulation.
products.whyThisHerb: Men's scalps have more sebum and shorter hair cycles. Sesame absorbs fast enough for a 2-minute morning routine. Rosemary and peppermint are both shown in small studies to increase scalp blood flow — a mechanical boon to follicles.

reviews.name: Arjun K.
reviews.text: First hair oil that doesn't feel like my grandmother's.

products.name: Keshini
products.subtitle: Rosemary & Peppermint Men's Thinning Oil
products.tagline: For the thinning you noticed last month.
products.description: Our heavier men's formula. Rosemary, peppermint, and a touch of capsaicin — for the man who wants to fight thinning seriously.
products.whyThisHerb: Rosemary oil at 2% has been compared favourably to minoxidil in one small trial for androgenetic alopecia. We use it at 3%. Capsaicin at 0.01% causes a subtle warming — mild micro-circulation. Not a miracle, but a real fighter.

howToUse.title: Night
howToUse.description: Apply at night, 3 times a week.

reviews.name: Kunal D.
reviews.text: 3 months in — visible new growth at temples.

reviews.name: Siddharth V.
reviews.text: The tingle tells you it's working. Give it time.

reviews.name: Aakash R.
reviews.text: Expensive but a bottle lasts 6 weeks.

products.name: Sariva
products.subtitle: Anantmool & Tulsi Scalp Reset
products.tagline: For scalps that need healing.
products.description: For scalps that have been through something — psoriasis, folliculitis, or just a bad reaction to shampoo. Anantmool and tulsi are the gentle healers.
products.whyThisHerb: Anantmool is Ayurveda's quiet healer — used in psoriasis and eczema formulas because it moderates the skin's inflammatory response. We use it at a lower concentration than you'd find in skin oils, because scalp skin is thinner than face.

reviews.name: Sneha R.
reviews.text: My folliculitis flares have calmed down.

products.name: Mahabhringraj
products.subtitle: Intense Bhringraj Regrowth Oil
products.tagline: For a hairline that needs persuading.
products.description: Bhringraj at the highest concentration we can extract — 32%. This is our most concentrated formula, for those fighting visible regrowth.
products.whyThisHerb: Most bhringraj oils use 5–10%. We use 32% — the maximum a cold-press can carry. It's intense, it's expensive, and it's the closest thing to Ayurveda's traditional bhringraj tailam we've been able to make at scale.

reviews.name: Reema T.
reviews.text: I have baby hairs at 34. First time.

reviews.name: Sameer J.
reviews.text: The most honest bhringraj oil on the market.

products.name: Chandanadi
products.subtitle: Sandalwood & Neem Cooling Oil
products.tagline: For scalps that run hot.
products.description: Sandalwood cools. Neem clarifies. Coconut delivers. The oil for summer, for humid cities, for scalps that flare in the heat.
products.whyThisHerb: Sandalwood's santalols are anti-inflammatory and mildly antiseptic — the reason it's been used in Indian skincare for 2,000 years. We pair it with vetiver, which Ayurveda calls the cooling root.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Wash. Use in summer, twice weekly.

reviews.name: Nisha M.
reviews.text: My scalp used to itch every summer. Not anymore.

products.name: Yastimadhu
products.subtitle: Licorice & Amla Split-End Repair
products.tagline: For hair that's been through bleach.
products.description: For hair recovering from coloring, heat, or just time. Yastimadhu (licorice) coats the shaft and reduces the friction that causes split ends.
products.whyThisHerb: Split ends can't be repaired, but they can be sealed. Yastimadhu's glycyrrhizin forms a film on the cuticle that mimics a leave-in conditioner without silicone. Argan adds a slip layer that reduces the friction — the actual cause of new splits.

howToUse.title: Comb
howToUse.description: Comb through with a wide-tooth comb.

products.name: Japa
products.subtitle: Hibiscus & Rose Frizz Control
products.tagline: For hair that wants to stay.
products.description: The lighter frizz tamer. For curly hair that wants hold without weight.
products.whyThisHerb: Curly hair needs oil on the ends, not the roots. Japa's hibiscus mucilage — a natural polymer — gives curls a light cast that defines without crunch.

products.name: Triphala
products.subtitle: Triphala Scalp Detox Oil
products.tagline: For scalps that have been through too much.
products.description: Triphala — three fruits — in an oil. For scalps that feel heavy from years of product.
products.whyThisHerb: Triphala is Ayurveda's most studied formula — three fruits, each at a different pH, working together to balance gut flora. We borrow the same logic for scalp flora.

howToUse.title: Apply
howToUse.description: Apply to scalp, section by section.

reviews.name: Pooja S.
reviews.text: My scalp feels lighter. Hair bouncier.

products.name: Arjunadi
products.subtitle: Arjuna & Brahmi Stress-Shed Oil
products.tagline: For hair that's tired of holding you together.
products.description: For telogen effluvium — the hair loss that comes from stress, illness, or big life changes. Arjuna for the heart, brahmi for the mind.
products.whyThisHerb: Arjuna has been used in Ayurvedic cardiology for 1,500 years — it moderates the body's response to stress. Combined with brahmi and ashwagandha, this is our formula for the hair loss that started when life got hard.

reviews.name: Neelam K.
reviews.text: After my divorce, my hair fell in clumps. This helped.

products.name: Karanja
products.subtitle: Karanja & Neem Scalp Purifier
products.tagline: For the scalp issue you don't talk about.
products.description: Karanja oil is Ayurveda's antiparasitic. For lice, for stubborn scalp infections, for the things that need a stronger hand.
products.whyThisHerb: Karanja's karanjin is a natural insecticide — it's why the tree's oil has been used for skin parasites for centuries. Not a pleasant oil, but an honest one.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Wash. Repeat 3 times weekly until resolved.

reviews.name: Sunita M.
reviews.text: Lice in my daughter's hair — gone in 10 days.

reviews.name: Ramya K.
reviews.text: Smell is strong but it works.

products.name: Devadaru
products.subtitle: Cedarwood & Vetiver Men's Scalp Oil
products.tagline: For the man who wants his scalp to feel like a forest.
products.description: Cedarwood and vetiver — the two masculine notes in Ayurvedic perfumery, paired with a clarifying base for men's scalps.
products.whyThisHerb: Devadaru is the Sanskrit name for the Himalayan cedar — a tree whose wood has been burned in Indian temples for 3,000 years. Its oil clarifies and grounds. Vetiver keeps it from feeling sharp.

reviews.name: Aman S.
reviews.text: Smells like a temple in the mountains.

products.name: Shubhra
products.subtitle: Coconut & Almond Gentle Oil
products.tagline: For the smallest heads in the house.
products.description: For children 3+. Two carriers, no essential oils, no fragrance. The simplest formula we make.
products.whyThisHerb: Children's scalps are thinner and more sensitive. We leave out every essential oil, every fragrance, every botanical extract that could irritate. This is oil, as simple as oil can be.

reviews.name: Ritu K.
reviews.text: My daughter's hair is finally soft.

reviews.name: Neha P.
reviews.text: Only oil I use on my twins.
